crossRefs.note: The king sent and called for Shimei, and said to him, “Build yourself a house in Jerusalem, and live there, and don’t…
When king David came to Bahurim, behold, a man of the family of Saul’s house came out, whose name was Shimei, the son…
Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, who was of Bahurim, hurried and came down with the men of Judah to meet king…
and you will swear, ‘As Yahweh lives,’ in truth, in justice, and in righteousness. The nations will bless themselves in…

people.name: Bahurim
people.line: Village near Jerusalem, home of Shimei, who cursed David.

people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Gera
people.line: Benjamite; cursed David during Absalom's rebellion; later sought forgiveness.

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

people.name: Mahanaim
people.line: A place east of the Jordan; David's refuge

people.name: Shimei
people.line: Benjamite who cursed David during Absalom's rebellion.

translations.web: “Behold, there is with you Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, of Bahurim, who cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim; but he came down to meet me at the Jordan, and I swore to him by Yahweh, saying, ‘I will not put you to death with the sword.’
translations.bsb: Keep an eye on Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite from Bahurim who is with you. He called down bitter curses against me on the day I went to Mahanaim, but when he came down to meet me at the Jordan, I swore to him by the LORD: ‘I will never put you to the sword.’
translations.kjv: And, behold, thou hast with thee Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite of Bahurim, which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim: but he came down to meet me at Jordan, and I sware to him by the LORD, saying, I will not put thee to death with the sword.
translations.asv: And, behold, there is with thee Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, of Bahurim, who cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim; but he came down to meet me at the Jordan, and I sware to him by Jehovah, saying, I will not put thee to death with the sword.
